# netactuate_firewall_set_detach_all_vms (Resource)

Detaches all VMs from a firewall set as an explicit action resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_firewall_set_detach_all_vms" "example" {
  firewall_set_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `firewall_set_id` (Number) Firewall set ID whose VM attachments are detached.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_firewall_set_detach_all_vms.example 12345
```
